catalogUrls.evidence: Operator-judgment field — both shapes are defensible. /shop/ (R1) provides 100% customer-visible coverage (4469 verified via 'Showing 1-40 of 4469 results' = WC Store x-wp-total). Per-category list (DB, 30 URLs) provides redundant coverage; sum-of-categories=9925 with 2.22x cross-listing factor; product-count-probe.ts:333-444 (stream-page-count arm) walks each catalogUrl and dedupes via product ID — extra URLs cost crawler tokens but don't break correctness. With expectedProductCount=11357 (WP REST universe), NEITHER /shop/ nor the 30 customer-visible categories cover 100% — both miss draft/private products that exist in WP REST. Conclusion: catalogUrls is for HTML-fallback walks only; with woocommerce.ts using WP REST as primary, catalogUrls is largely a redundancy spine. INCONCLUSIVE — neither value is wrong; R1's minimum-URL choice has merit, DB's redundancy has merit. No live evidence forces one shape.
